node.statement: By the nonvanishing alternative in def-delta-projection, applied to the pair from node 1.1, there is a universal e_nv in (0,e_np] such that epsilon_X<=e_nv implies ||q_1||>=1/2 and ||q_2||>=1/2. Indeed nonvanishing gives | ||q_i||-1 |<=O(C_np*epsilon_X+epsilon_X), with a universal data-independent coefficient, so one common shrink works for both i.
